description: Playbook triage: one ripe, one stale; no edits without the user.
prompt: Use the setup-retro skill. Focus on my playbooks in docs/playbooks/ (the skills are in .claude/skills). Report in chat only and do not write files.

assertions.desc: Every playbook is listed with its status, runs and last_run.
The OCR playbook (current, 4 runs, steps unchanged) is classified as ripe for promotion to a skill.
The VM-image playbook (draft, one run, last run 2026-02-01) is classified as stale, with re-verify or deprecate as the fix.

The promotion path is stated: the skill is drafted from the playbook's steps and the run log's gotchas after the user agrees, and the playbook then becomes deprecated with a link to the skill. The assistant does not promote on its own.
No playbook or skill file was changed.
The action plan separates what the user does from what Claude does.
